# std.prefix

Prefix sums, prefix/suffix monoid folds, and offline difference arrays.  Call `Prefix(a)` on a `[D]T`, `[R, C]T`, or `List<T>` to build static prefix sums in \(O(n)\) or \(O(r \cdot c)\), then answer any `.fold(...)`, `.cut(k)` or `.prefix(...)` query in \(O(1)\). Use `Diff<D, T>()` or `Diff<R, C, T>()` for \(O(1)\) offline range/rectangle adds and \(O(n)\) / \(O(r \cdot c)\) `finish()`.

In prelude (no `use` needed): `Diff`, `Prefix`, `scan`.

## `enum FillOrder`

Fill direction for an append-only `Prefix.filling(...)` table.

## `struct FillPrefix<D, T: Add + Sub>`

Append-only 1-D prefix/suffix sum table returned by `Prefix<D, T>.filling(...)`.

Fields: `p: [D.cuts]T`.

- `fn set(mut self, i: D, x: T)` — \(O(1)\); Write the next cell in fill order (`D.first..=D.last` for `Forward`, reverse for `Reverse`).; traps: when `i` is not the next position in fill order (out of order, repeated, or after
- `fn prefix(self, b: Cut<D>) -> T` — \(O(1)\); The sum of everything left of boundary `b`; zero at the first cut.; traps: when a position left of `b` is not yet written (with `Reverse`, every position left
- `fn at(self, c: Cut<D>) -> T` — \(O(1)\); `f[c]`: the same as `prefix(c)`, as on a built `Prefix`; at a position `v`, `f[v]` is the sum through `v`, the same as `f[v.r]` (R07.1.6).; traps: when a position left of `c` is not yet written
- `fn cut(self, k: Int) -> T` — \(O(1)\); The sum of the first `k` positions, whatever `D`'s base: `prefix` at the cut `k` positions in.; traps: when `k` is not in `0..=D.count`, or a position among the first `k` is not yet written
- `fn fold(self, r: Range<D>) -> T` — \(O(1)\); The sum of `a[i]` for `i` in `r`, or `0` when `r` is empty.; traps: when `r` is non-empty and contains a position not yet written

## `struct Prefix<D, T: Add + Sub>`

Prefix sums over a domain `D`, a 2-D grid `(R, C)`, or a `List<T>`, of `Int`s, `F64`s, `Mod`s, or anything else with `+`, `-` and a zero.

Fields: `p: [D.cuts]T`, `sums: Bool`, `rises: Bool`, `back: Bool`.

- `fn new(a: [D]T) -> Prefix<D, T>` — \(O(\lvert D \rvert)\) time and space; Build 1-D prefix sums over `a: [D]T`; `Prefix(a)` calls it.
- `fn filling(order: FillOrder = FillOrder.Forward) -> FillPrefix<D, T>` — \(O(\lvert D \rvert)\) time and space; Create an append-only 1-D prefix/suffix sum table filled via `.set(i, x)` in `order`.
- `fn prefix(self, b: Cut<D>) -> T` — \(O(1)\); The sum of everything left of boundary `b`: zero at the first cut, `all` at the last.; traps: on a suffix table (`a.rev.scan(f)`) with `f` other than `+`, which subtracts
- `fn of_rev_scan<M>(a: [D]T, f: M, from: ?T) -> Prefix<D, T>`
- `fn fold(self, r: Range<D>) -> T` — \(O(1)\); The sum of `a[i]` for `i` in `r`, or `0` when `r` is empty: `prefix(r.r) - prefix(r.l)`.; traps: on a table from `scan(f)` with `f` other than `+`
- `fn cyclic_sum(self, r: RingRange<D>) -> T` — \(O(1)\); The sum over a wrapping run of positions, e.g.; traps: on a table from `scan(f)` with `f` other than `+`
- `fn at(self, c: Cut<D>) -> T` — \(O(1)\); `p[c]`: the sum of everything left of cut `c`, the same as `prefix(c)`; at a position `v`, `p[v]` is the sum through `v`, the same as `p[v.r]` (R07.1.6).
- `fn cut(self, k: Int) -> T` — \(O(1)\); The fold of the first `k` positions, whatever `D`'s base: the value at the cut `k` positions in, the identity at `0` and `all` at `D.count`.; traps: when `k` is not in `0..=D.count`
- `fn suffix(self, b: Cut<D>) -> T` — \(O(1)\); The sum of everything right of boundary `b`: `all - prefix(b)`, zero at the last cut.; traps: on a table from `scan(f)` with `f` other than `+`
- `@get fn all(self) -> T` — \(O(1)\); The sum of the entire domain: `prefix` at the last cut (a suffix table's first), zero for an empty domain.
- `fn first_ge(self, target: T) -> ?Cut<D>` — \(O(\log \lvert D \rvert)\); The first boundary `b` with `prefix(b) >= target`, or `None` when even `all` is smaller.; traps: when some element is negative
- `fn first_gt(self, target: T) -> ?Cut<D>` — \(O(\log \lvert D \rvert)\); The first boundary `b` with `prefix(b) > target`, or `None` when `all <= target`.; traps: when some element is negative

## `struct _FillPrefix2 <R, C, T: Add + Sub>`

Internal append-only 2-D prefix/suffix sum table returned by `Prefix<R, C, T>.filling(...)`.

Fields: `p: [R.cuts, C.cuts]T`.

- `fn set(mut self, r: R, c: C, x: T)` — \(O(1)\); Write the next cell in row-major fill order (top-left to bottom-right for `Forward`, bottom-right to top-left for `Reverse`).; traps: when `(r, c)` is not the next cell in fill order
- `fn prefix(self, r: Cut<R>, c: Cut<C>) -> T` — \(O(1)\); The sum of everything above row boundary `r` and left of column boundary `c`; zero when either cut is the first.; traps: when that rectangle is non-empty and holds a cell not yet written
- `fn fold(self, rows: Range<R>, cols: Range<C>) -> T` — \(O(1)\); The sum of `a[r, c]` over `rows` by `cols`, or `0` when either range is empty.; traps: when the rectangle is non-empty and holds a cell not yet written

## `struct _Prefix2 <R, C, T: Add + Sub>`

Internal 2-D shape of `Prefix<R, C, T>`, constructed by `Prefix(a)` or `Prefix<R, C, T>.filling(...)`.

Fields: `p: [R.cuts, C.cuts]T`.

- `fn new(a: [R, C]T) -> Prefix<R, C, T>` — \(O(\lvert R \rvert \cdot \lvert C \rvert)\) time and space; Build 2-D prefix sums over `a: [R, C]T`; `Prefix(a)` on a grid calls it.
- `fn filling(order: FillOrder = FillOrder.Forward) -> FillPrefix<R, C, T>` — \(O(\lvert R \rvert \cdot \lvert C \rvert)\) time and space; Create an append-only 2-D prefix/suffix sum table filled via `.set(r, c, x)` in row-major `order`.
- `fn prefix(self, r: Cut<R>, c: Cut<C>) -> T` — \(O(1)\); The sum of everything above row boundary `r` and left of column boundary `c`; zero when either cut is the first.
- `fn fold(self, rows: Range<R>, cols: Range<C>) -> T` — \(O(1)\); The sum of `a[r, c]` over `rows` by `cols`, or `0` when either range is empty, by inclusion-exclusion over the four corner cuts.

## `struct _FillPrefixList <T: Add + Sub>`

Internal append-only list prefix/suffix sum table returned by `Prefix<T>.filling(n, ...)`.

Fields: `p: List<T>`.

- `fn set(mut self, i: Int, x: T)` — \(O(1)\); Write index `i` in fill order (`0..n` for `Forward`, `(0..n).rev` for `Reverse`).; traps: when `i` is not the next index in fill order (including any `i` outside `0..n`)
- `fn cut(self, k: Int) -> T` — \(O(1)\); The sum of the first `k` values; zero for `k == 0`.; traps: when `k` is not in `0..=n`, or one of the first `k` values is not yet written
- `fn fold(self, r: Range<Int>) -> T` — \(O(1)\); The sum of `a[i]` for `i` in `r`, or zero when `r` is empty.; traps: when `r` is non-empty and reaches outside `0..n` or holds an index not yet written

## `struct _PrefixList <T: Sub>`

Internal list shape of `Prefix<T>`, constructed by `Prefix(a)` or `Prefix<T>.filling(n, ...)`.

Fields: `p: List<T>`.

- `fn new(a: List<T>) -> Prefix<T>` — \(O(a.\mathit{len})\) time and space; Build 1-D prefix sums over `a: List<T>`; `Prefix(a)` on a list calls it.
- `fn filling(n: Int, order: FillOrder = FillOrder.Forward) -> FillPrefix<T>` — \(O(n)\) time and space; Create an append-only 1-D prefix/suffix sum table of length `n`, filled via `.set(i, x)` in `order`.; traps: when `n < 0`
- `fn cut(self, k: Int) -> T` — \(O(1)\); The sum of the first `k` values; zero for `k == 0`.; traps: when `k` is not in `0..=n`
- `fn fold(self, r: Range<Int>) -> T` — \(O(1)\); The sum of `a[i]` for `i` in `r`, or zero when `r` is empty.; traps: when `r` is non-empty and reaches outside `0..n`

## `struct Diff<D, T: Add + Sub>`

Offline difference array: `Diff<D, T>()` for 1-D ranges or `Diff<R, C, T>()` for 2-D grids.

Fields: `d: [D.cuts]T`.

- `fn new() -> Diff<D, T>` — \(O(\lvert D \rvert)\) time and space; Create an all-zero 1-D difference array over `D`.
- `fn add(mut self, r: Range<D>, x: T)` — \(O(1)\); Add `x` to every position in `r`; an empty `r` changes nothing.
- `fn finish(self) -> [D]T` — \(O(\lvert D \rvert)\) time and space; The accumulated values across `D`: each position's total of the `add`s covering it.

## `struct _Diff2 <R, C, T: Add + Sub>`

Internal 2-D shape of `Diff<R, C, T>`: \(O(1)\) rectangle `add`, \(O(\lvert R \rvert \cdot \lvert C \rvert)\) `finish`.

Fields: `d: [R.cuts, C.cuts]T`.

- `fn new() -> Diff<R, C, T>` — \(O(\lvert R \rvert \cdot \lvert C \rvert)\) time and space; Create an all-zero 2-D difference array over `(R, C)`.
- `fn add(mut self, rows: Range<R>, cols: Range<C>, x: T)` — \(O(1)\); Add `x` to every cell in `rows` by `cols`; an empty side changes nothing.
- `fn finish(self) -> [R, C]T` — \(O(\lvert R \rvert \cdot \lvert C \rvert)\) time and space; The accumulated grid across `(R, C)`: each cell's total of the `add`s covering it.

## `struct SweepAdd<D, T: Add + Sub>`

\(O(\lvert D \rvert)\) space.

Fields: `d: [D.cuts]T`, `cur: T`.

- `fn new(order: FillOrder = FillOrder.Forward) -> SweepAdd<D, T>` — \(O(\lvert D \rvert)\) time and space; Create an all-zero online sweep accumulator in `order` (`Forward` or `Reverse`), with no position advanced yet.
- `fn add(mut self, r: Range<D>, x: T)` — \(O(1)\); Schedule `+x` across `r`, which must start at or ahead of the current sweep cursor: no position of `r` may have been advanced past already.; traps: when `r` is non-empty and holds a position already advanced to
- `fn advance(mut self, i: D) -> T` — \(O(1)\); Advance the cursor to `i`, the next position in fill order, and return the accumulated value there: the total of every scheduled `add` covering `i`.; traps: when `i` is not the next position in fill order
- `@get fn current(self) -> T` — \(O(1)\); The accumulated value at the most recently advanced position, as `advance` returned it.; traps: when no position has been advanced yet

## `struct ArithDiff<D, T: Add + Sub + Mul>`

\(O(\lvert D \rvert)\) space.

Fields: `d: [D.cuts]T`, `e: [D.cuts]T`.

- `fn new() -> ArithDiff<D, T>` — \(O(\lvert D \rvert)\) time and space; Create an all-zero second-order difference array over `D`.
- `fn add_arith(mut self, r: Range<D>, start: T, step: T)` — \(O(1)\); Add `start + step * (i.ord - r.start.ord)` to every position `i` in `r`: `start` at the first position of `r`, growing by `step` per position.
- `fn add(mut self, r: Range<D>, x: T)` — \(O(1)\); Add a constant `x` to every position in `r`: `add_arith(r, x, 0)`.
- `fn finish(self) -> [D]T` — \(O(\lvert D \rvert)\) time and space; The accumulated values across `D`.

## Functions

- `fn scan<D, T, M>(self: [D]T, f: M, from: ?T = None) -> Prefix<D, T>` — \(O(n)\) calls of `f`; \(O(n)\) space; \(O(n)\) calls of `f`.; traps: never (beyond what `f` traps on); see `fold` for range reads
- `fn prefix_fold<D, T, M>(op: M, a: [D]T) -> [D.cuts]T` — \(O(n)\) calls of `op`; \(O(n)\) space; Prefix monoid folds of `a`, indexed by `Cut<D>`: `p[b]` is the fold of `..b`, with `p[D.cuts.nth(0)] == m.id`.; traps: never (beyond what `op` traps on)
- `fn suffix_fold<D, T, M>(op: M, a: [D]T) -> [D.cuts]T` — \(O(n)\) calls of `op`; \(O(n)\) space; Suffix monoid folds of `a`, indexed by `Cut<D>`: `s[b]` is the fold of `b..`, with `s[D.cuts.nth(D.count)] == m.id`.; traps: never (beyond what `op` traps on)

## Example

let p = Prefix([2, 5, 3])
print(p.all)
